title: Profit Model V3 symmetric regime breakout with causal forward-edge model

independence.selection_disclosure: This is a new architecture and symmetric trend hypothesis. It is not a validation or relabeling of H12/HY-EXP-0018.

data.source_type: Binance official public 5m contract klines plus realized funding archives
data.point_in_time_rule: Only completed bars, prior rolling quote volume and observations available at decisionTime may affect a candidate or universe snapshot.
data.quality_rule: Verify source manifest and every source file hash before parsing; reject missing, duplicate, non-contiguous or incomplete 4h bars.

universe.selection: All symbols in the locked source manifest are reconsidered at every 4h decision; eligibility is not a fixed six-symbol list.
universe.promotion_rule: A historical OHLCV depth proxy is not sufficient for promotion; real historical order-book depth must be captured in a later experiment.

regime.bull_rule: BTC fast SMA is strictly above slow SMA, BTC close is above slow SMA and at least half of the current PIT universe is above its own slow SMA.
regime.bear_rule: BTC fast SMA is strictly below slow SMA, BTC close is below slow SMA and at least half of the current PIT universe is below its own slow SMA.
regime.sideways_rule: Any state not satisfying the bull or bear rule is SIDEWAYS and produces NO_TRADE.

entry.bull: LONG when completed close is strictly above the prior 120-bar high; fill at the next bar using the executable research book.
entry.bear: SHORT when completed close is strictly below the prior 120-bar low; fill at the next bar using the executable research book.
entry.breakout_distance_role: Feature metadata only; it is never assigned as expectedPriceEdgeBps.

exit.long: Exit on an intrabar two-ATR stop or a close below the prior 60-bar low.
exit.short: Exit on an intrabar two-ATR stop or a close above the prior 60-bar high.
exit.terminal: Close at the final complete 4h bar; this is separate from edge-model research horizon.

edge_model.estimator: Causal expanding mean of prior same-side/same-regime forward price-return labels with sample standard error.
edge_model.oos_training: Freeze training at development_end_exclusive_utc; no OOS labels may enter the final OOS edge estimate.
edge_model.trade_rule: Only conservative executable edge after fee, spread, slippage, impact, latency, funding and uncertainty clears the existing Net Edge cost/risk hurdle may become an Advisory.

execution.funding: Use realized funding archives for every event from entry through exit, including holding-period statistics.

validation.win_rate_role: Supplementary only; not the optimization target.
validation.threshold_policy: Do not lower existing thresholds to increase signal count.

decision.first_version: Research-only result; no promotion decision from this run.
decision.promotion: Requires real historical depth, independent forward paper validation and a separately reviewed experiment record.
decision.change_policy: Any change to dates, universe filters, regime, breakout channels, edge labels, purge, costs, funding, sizing or risk limits requires a new experiment ID.
